title: Judge dismisses Trump attempt to block Alaska Senate race results if Republican loses
hook: Judge dismisses Trump attempt to block Alaska Senate race results if Republican loses

beats.caption: Judge dismisses Trump attempt to block Alaska Senate race results if Republican loses
This wasn't just a legal dispute.
beats.detail: The Alaska Senate race certification was targeted.
beats.narration: That is not a simple legal debate. That is a direct challenge to how an entire state counts its votes.

beats.caption: Trump tried to stop certification.
beats.detail: The lawsuit targeted the election outcome.
beats.narration: A Trump backed lawsuit tried to block the results of the Alaska Senate race.

beats.caption: The goal was to block the outcome.
beats.detail: Trump ordered the lawsuit to be filed.
beats.narration: Donald Trump wanted to stop the results if the Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan happened to lose.

beats.caption: Sullivan vowed to accept the results.
beats.detail: He called the lawsuit an unprecedented intervention.
beats.narration: Incumbent Dan Sullivan stepped in. He said he would accept the election results regardless of the outcome.

beats.caption: The judge dismissed the lawsuit.
beats.detail: The legal challenge was successfully thrown out.
beats.narration: A judge has now dismissed the case. The attempt to block the certification is over.

beats.caption: The process moves forward.
beats.detail: Alaska election results remain on track.
beats.narration: This ruling keeps the certification process moving forward in Alaska without legal interference from the former president.
